ROUTE: Plover-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior routing: this math question has a single correct answer and clear completion criteria, which matches Plover's self-reported top-rated task family (well-specified retrieval/reformatting with definite endpoints). It also edges Avocet slightly on the quantitative-reasoning benchmarks (MMLU-Pro 75.9 vs 74.8, GPQA 56.2 vs 54.3), though that gap is small. The internal eval categories don't map cleanly to a bounded math problem, so I leaned on the preference fit plus the marginal benchmark edge. Note the preference is dissociated from measured quality, so this is a tie-breaker, not a strong capability claim.
